§6Steel Furnace§f

§aThree slots, bonus output, and it runs on heat. The workhorse of NTM smelting.§f

The §bSteel Furnace§f runs on §bTU§f from a firebox or heating oven. Three input slots process simultaneously, and you get a bonus: every 4 items smelted yields a 5th free item for ores and wood.

Crafted at a §bTier 2 Anvil§f from stone bricks, iron ingots, steel plates, red copper, and steel grates.

Heat transfer rate is ΔT × 0.05 TU/t per active slot. Pair it with a strong heat source for best throughput.

§ePS:§f Great for automation. The multi-slot processing and bonus yield make it the best furnace for bulk smelting.
